scope: Theorem 13.1 (Mullin encoding and its infinite version) of the manuscript “Metric-measure limits of subcritical FK and spanning-tree planar maps” (preprints/Metric-measure-limits-of-subcritical-FK-and-spanning-tree-planar-maps-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1dd659698d3a3fde), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 163. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Rooted spherical map–spanning-tree pairs with n edges are in bijection with length-2n axial walks starting at the origin, remaining in Z2 ≥0, and ending at the origin. The reconstruction is (13.2)– (13.3), with the contour order supplying the embedding and root. Thus uniform pairs correspond exactly to the walk conditioned on this excursion event. Applying the bilateral sewing gives the uniform infinite spanning-tree decorated planar map M.
